title: Rainstorm Precipitation
subtitle: Terminal Velocity Vectors & Impact Ripples
description: Meteorological atmospheric downpour integrating aerodynamic terminal velocity fall rates, aerodynamic wind shear slant, and damped Bessel ground collision ripples.
mathNotation: v_{\text{term}} = \sqrt{\frac{2 m g}{\rho A C_d}}, \quad \mathbf{v} = v_{\text{term}} \begin{bmatrix} \sin\theta_{\text{wind}} \\ \cos\theta_{\text{wind}} \end{bmatrix}, \quad r_{\text{ripple}}(t) = v_{\text{wave}} (t - t_{\text{impact}})
formulaCompact: y += speed * dt,  x += speed * sin(wind) * dt,  ripple = ellipse(x, y, r, 0.35r) * exp(-γt)
